Method of Attack: Authentication bypass zero-day in Cisco IOS XE Web UI feature allowing unauthenticated attackers to gain full administrator privileges and control of routers and switches remotely
Creation of local user accounts with privilege level 15 access
Deployment of malicious implant via CVE-2021-1435 exploits and other unknown methods to execute arbitrary commands at system or IOS levels
Impacted Systems: Cisco IOS XE software devices with Web UI and HTTP/HTTPS Server features enabled
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Web User Interface (Web UI) feature exposed to internet or untrusted networks with HTTP or HTTPS Server feature enabled
Indicators of Compromise: Local user accounts named 'cisco_tac_admin' and 'cisco_support' created from suspicious IP addresses 5.149.249.74 and 154.53.56.231
Malicious implant presence detectable via curl command to DEVICEIP/webui/logoutconfirm.html?logon_hash=1
